description: IBCS trend with reference line. Actual capital spend as a solid black line over a dashed grey Plan reference (IBCS rule: never a single series alone). Page 2 (Cash flow / working capital trend). Deneb dataset fields required: year, scenario, amount. NOT PUBLISHED for the City of Vancouver dataset: no fiscal year carries both an Actual and a Plan (AC=2023-25, PL=2026 never overlap), so this renders blank or as a 3yr-vs-1yr artifact here; kept for a source that has same-period AC+PL. See 09-yoy-plan-vs-actual for the honest year-over-year comparison this data supports.

title.text: Actual capital spend versus plan, 2023 to 2026
title.subtitle: Actual = solid black line  ·  Plan = dashed grey reference line
